title: Green exposure, open-mindedness, and creative performance
statement:
Exposure to the color green, even briefly, facilitates open-mindedness and enhances creative performance compared to white, gray, red, or blue.

Options:
- Creative Facilitation: #4CAF50 (Standard Green) (fits: brainstorming apps, design tools)
- Subtle Growth: #E8F5E9 (Light Green) (fits: learning management, writing tools)
- Analytical Baseline: #FFFFFF (White) (fits: data entry, strict compliance)
appliesWhen: Applies to: productivity tools, education tech. Audience: general, adults, children under 10.

source.title: Fertile Green: Green Facilitates Creative Performance
source.authors: Stephanie Lichtenfeld; Andrew J. Elliot; Markus A. Maier; Reinhard Pekrun
